A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

Stoat, the state of the art UI test generation tool for Android, is able to achieve better coverage than Monkey, a widely-used state of the practice UI test generation tool, on 22 out of 68 industrial apps under study, and Stoat is also able to trigger the most number of crashes on 23 out of 68 apps.
Stoat is the best test generation tool in terms of code coverage, Monkey is the best tool in terms of activity coverage, and Monkey is the best in terms of unique crash triggering.
Stoat is the most effective tool for finding crashes, Monkey is the most effective for code coverage, and Monkey is the most easy to use.
The main takeaway from our work is that
there is no one size fits all test generation tool for industrial apps, and it is necessary to select the right tools for a given app based on its complexity and testing goal.
the effectiveness and ease of test generation tools on industrial apps is highly dependent on the complexity of apps under test.
there is no single best test generation tool for all Android apps.
